 Memphis Grizzlies High School Sports Golf Grizzlies Podcast Tigers Basketball Tigers Football Player of the Week Add Daily Memphian to Home Screen Memphis Grizzlies Grizzlies win fifth straight road game, beating Raptors in Toronto 
 By Drew Hill , Daily Memphian Updated: November 10, 2026 10:01 AM CT | Published: November 09, 2026 9:49 PM CT Toronto Raptors Jamal Shead (1) drives past Memphis Grizzlies' Ty Jerome (2) and Cameron Boozer (27) during the first half of an NBA basketball game in Toronto on Monday, Nov. 9, 2026. (Frank Gunn/The Canadian Press via AP)
 After a three-game losing streak at home, the Grizzlies returned to the road and won their fifth consecutive road game.
 Related content:
 Box score: Grizzlies 118, Raptors 102 
 Topics
 NBA basketball Memphis Grizzlies Toronto Raptors Drew Hill
 Drew Hill covers the Memphis Grizzlies and is a top-10 APSE winner. He has worked throughout the South writing about college athletics before landing in Memphis.
